MetricLabel: accessibility of the SPARQL endpoint and the server
Definition: checking whether the server responds to a SPARQL query
checking whether an RDF dump is provided and can be downloaded
checking (i) for dead or broken links, (ii) that useful data (particularly RDF) is returned upon lookup of a URI, and (iii) compliance with recommended redirections using status code 303 See Other
detect whether the HTTP response contains the header field stating the appropriate content type of the returned file, e.g. application/rdf+xml
dereferenceability of all forward links: all available triples where the local URI is mentioned in the subject
detection of the indication of a license in the VoID description or in the dataset itself
detection of a license in the documentation of the dataset
detection of whether the dataset is attributed under the same license as the original

detection of good quality interlinks using network measures such as interlinking degree, clustering coefficient, centrality, open sameAs chains, and description richness through sameAs; also assessable via crowdsourcing

MetricLabel: existence of links to external data providers
Definition: detection of the existence and usage of external URIs, e.g. using owl:sameAs links
detection of all local in-links or back-links: all triples from a dataset that have the resource’s URI as the object
signing a document containing an RDF serialization, a SPARQL result set, or signing an RDF graph
verifying authenticity of the dataset based on provenance vocabulary such as author, contributors, publisher, and sources
checking for usage of slash-URIs where large amounts of data is provided
minimum delay between submission of a request by the user and reception of the response from the system
maximum number of answered HTTP requests per second
detection of whether the time to answer ten requests divided by ten is not longer than the time it takes to answer one request

MetricLabel: no syntax errors of the documents
Definition: detecting syntax errors using validators or via crowdsourcing
use of explicit definition of allowed values for a datatype, syntactic rules, RDF pattern conformance, typed resources, and outlier/clustering techniques for wrong values
detection of ill-typed literals that do not abide by the lexical syntax for their datatype
detection of outliers using distance-based, deviation-based, distribution-based methods, or statistical distributions of a certain type
detection of inaccurate values using functional dependencies, comparison between two literal values of a resource, or crowdsourcing

MetricLabel: no inaccurate annotations, labellings or classifications
Definition: detection of inaccurate annotations, labellings or classifications using the balanced distance metric
Formula: 1 − inaccurate instances / total no. of instances * balanced distance metric / total no. of instances

Definition: detection of discordant values or misused properties using profiling statistics
ratio of the number of semantically valid rules to the number of non-trivial rules
Formula: number of semantically valid rules / number of non-trivial rules

MetricLabel: no use of entities as members of disjoint classes
Definition: detection of use of entities as members of disjoint classes
Formula: no. of entities described as members of disjoint classes / total no. of entities described in the dataset

Definition: detection of misplaced classes or properties using entailment rules that indicate the position of a term in a triple

MetricLabel: no misuse of owl:DatatypeProperty or owl:ObjectProperty
Definition: detection of misuse of owl:DatatypeProperty or owl:ObjectProperty through the ontology maintainer

MetricLabel: members of owl:DeprecatedClass or owl:DeprecatedProperty not used
Definition: detection of use of deprecated classes/properties through the ontology maintainer or manual mappings
checking uniqueness and validity of inverse-functional values or defining a SPARQL query as a constraint
detection of re-definition by third parties of external classes/properties such that reasoning over data using those external terms is not affected
detection of negative dependencies/correlation among properties using association rules
detection of inconsistencies in spatial data through semantic and geometric constraints
the attribution of a resource’s property with a certain value is only valid if the resource, value, or literal value is of a certain type, detected using SPARQL queries as constraints
detection of inconsistent values by generating a set of schema axioms for all properties in a dataset and manually verifying these axioms
number of unique properties/classes of a dataset relative to the total number of properties/classes in a target schema
Formula: no. of unique properties/classes of a dataset / total no. of properties/classes in a target schema

Definition: number of unique objects of a dataset relative to the total number of object representations, or one minus the fraction of instances violating the uniqueness rule
Formula: (i) no. of unique objects of a dataset / total number of object representations in the dataset; (ii) 1 − total no. of instances that violate the uniqueness rule / total no. of relevant instances

Definition: detection of unambiguous annotations/labels
Formula: 1 − no. of ambiguous instances / no. of instances contained in the semantic metadata set

Definition: number of classes and properties represented relative to the total number of classes and properties
Formula: no. of classes and properties represented / total no. of classes and properties

Definition: number of values represented for a specific property relative to the total number of values for that property, or detection using statistical distributions of properties and types
Formula: (i) no. of values represented for a specific property / total no. of values for a specific property

Definition: number of real-world objects represented relative to the total number of real-world objects
Formula: no. of real-world objects represented / total no. of real-world objects

Definition: number of interlinked instances relative to total instances in a dataset, or percentage of mappable types not yet considered in linksets under assumed type alignment
Formula: (i) no. of instances in the dataset that are interlinked / total no. of instances in a dataset

Definition: obtaining relevant data by ranking RDF documents/statements or via crowdsourcing
measuring the coverage and level of detail in a dataset to ensure that the data retrieved is appropriate for the task at hand
computing statement trust values based on provenance information, opinion-based methods, provenance information and trust annotations in semantic web social networks, or provenance history
using annotations for data to encode blacklists and authority information

MetricLabel: trustworthiness of statements, datasets and rules
Definition: using trust ontologies that assign trust values transferable from known to unknown data using content-based or metadata-based methods
computing trust values between two entities through a path using propagation algorithms and aggregation across paths

computing trustworthiness of the information provider by construction of decision networks informed by provenance graphs, checking lists of trusted providers, or indicating publisher trust level on a 1–9 scale
checking content trust based on associations that transfer trust from content to resources
assignment of explicit trust ratings to the dataset by humans or analyzing external links or page ranks

MetricLabel: human-readable labelling of classes, properties and entities as well as presence of metadata
Definition: detection of human-readable labelling of classes, properties and entities as well as indication of metadata such as name, description, and website

MetricLabel: indication of one or more exemplary URIs
Definition: detect whether the pattern of the URIs is provided

MetricLabel: indication of a regular expression that matches the URIs of a dataset
Definition: detect whether a regular expression that matches the URIs is present

MetricLabel: indication of an exemplary SPARQL query
Definition: detect whether examples of SPARQL queries are provided

MetricLabel: indication of the vocabularies used in the dataset
Definition: checking whether a list of vocabularies used in the dataset is provided

MetricLabel: provision of message boards and mailing lists
Definition: checking the effectiveness and efficiency of the usage of the mailing list and/or message boards

MetricLabel: freshness of datasets based on currency and volatility
Definition: detecting freshness of datasets based on currency and volatility

MetricLabel: freshness of datasets based on their data source
Definition: detecting freshness of datasets based on their data source by measuring the distance between the last modified time of the data source and the last modified time of the dataset
detection of long URIs or those that contain query parameters

MetricLabel: no use of prolix RDF features
Definition: detection of RDF primitives such as RDF reification, RDF containers, and RDF collections
detection of whether existing terms from all relevant vocabularies for that particular domain have been reused
usage of relevant vocabularies for that particular domain
identifying objects and terms used to define these objects with globally unique identifiers
detecting the use of appropriate language, symbols, units, datatypes, and clear definitions

MetricLabel: invalid usage of undefined classes and properties
Definition: detection of invalid usage of undefined classes and properties, i.e. those without any formal definition
detecting the use of blank nodes

MetricLabel: provision of the data in different serialization formats
Definition: checking whether data is available in different serialization formats

MetricLabel: provision of the data in various languages
Definition: checking whether data is available in different languages
